name: four-ems
title: Self-Hosted Form Builder
description: Create multi-page forms with conditional logic, collect responses, and embed forms in external sites.
audience: Small business owners, event organisers, freelancers, and teams who need to collect structured information from people without paying for Typeform or Google Forms limitations.
useCases: A wedding planner sends guests a multi-page RSVP form — dietary requirements only appear if the guest selects 'attending', keeping the form short for declines
A small business embeds a quote request form on their website — collects project details, reviews submissions on a dashboard, and exports leads as CSV
A teacher creates a course feedback survey — uses conditional logic to ask follow-up questions only when a student rates something below 3 stars
A startup founder describes a form to ChatGPT, pastes the JSON output into the builder, and has a working intake form published in minutes

dataPrivacy.storage: Form definitions and submissions stored in Supabase cloud database with row-level security.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Supabase Auth. Form owners only see their own forms and submissions.
dataPrivacy.embedding: Published forms can be embedded in external sites via iframe.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Supabase for database. tool-till-tees API for email notifications.
